formal_voice.normative_candidate: Registry Context is the bounded resolution of source-current selected records and explicit typed bindings for one declared consumer and purpose, with every stale, missing, ambiguous, conflicting, open, or owner-unresolved matter preserved as residue.
formal_voice.expression: resolve(q, S) = V only if valid(q) and current(required_selections(q), S) and bindings(V) subset_of explicit_bindings(S); unresolved(S, q) subset_of residue(V)

symbols.meaning: the named source registries and selections

boundary_conditions: A changed required selection blocks resolution.
Whole-file change with unchanged selected bytes is diagnostic, not semantic admission.
Registry membership never creates a binding.
Resolution creates no authority or source mutation.

definitions.plain_language_voice: Registry Context gathers only the exact current pieces of product, Project, Goal, Language, definition, and binding information needed for one job and shows what is still unresolved.
definitions.domain_context_voice: For Define, Registry Context can connect the CyberAlchemy thesis, the Define Project and Goal, the Define capability, and the relevant Language bindings without loading or copying every package.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Use it before a capability begins or resumes work. The consumer declares its purpose and scope; resolution validates exact selections, follows only explicit bindings, and returns a digest-bound view plus residue.
definitions.forbidden_collapse: Not a canonical Definition, generic registry primitive, source of product truth, owner decision, authority envelope, event ledger, or accepted runtime.

formal_voice.normative_candidate: A Registry Context Request names one consumer, one purpose, a bounded product and work scope, exact registry anchors, required and optional source selections, a selection-currency policy, and an explicit-binding policy.
formal_voice.expression: Request = (id, consumer, purpose, scope, registry_queries, binding_policy, currency_policy, output_contract, authority_effect=none)

symbols.meaning: named registry anchors and selected values
the rule for deciding whether selected source material is current

boundary_conditions: The request cannot use an unbounded repository scan as a registry query.
Silence or a familiar label cannot satisfy a missing required selection.
The request grants no read, write, promotion, or execution authority.

definitions.plain_language_voice: It says who needs context, why they need it, and exactly which registry material may be used.
definitions.domain_context_voice: A Define request can name the Define Project and Goal, parent Product Thesis, Language registries, and canonical term sections needed for that session.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Validate the request before resolving any source. Treat undeclared selections as out of scope.
definitions.forbidden_collapse: Not an agent prompt, broad repository search, owner acceptance, or authorization to mutate a registry.

formal_voice.normative_candidate: A Registry Context View is an immutable candidate projection bound to its request digest and source epoch, containing included records, explicit typed bindings, visible residue, owners, and a claim ceiling.
formal_voice.expression: View = (id, request_digest, consumer, scope, source_epoch, records, explicit_bindings, residue, view_digest, authority_effect=none)

symbols.meaning: the deterministic digest of the exact selected source values
the deterministic digest of the view fields excluding the digest field itself

boundary_conditions: The view is stale when a required selection digest changes.
Open or conflicting realizations remain residue.
A view cannot transfer ownership or authority from its sources.

definitions.plain_language_voice: It is the small, inspectable context bundle a capability receives, together with proof of where it came from and what is still open.
definitions.domain_context_voice: Define can consume a Registry Context View and later preserve its identity, source epoch, and applied binding references in a Definition Pack.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Re-resolve instead of editing a stale view. Explain every included binding through exact source selections.
definitions.forbidden_collapse: Not a source registry, ledger, Definition Pack, accepted Language Context View, or proof that the consumer applied the context correctly.

formal_voice.normative_candidate: A Registry Context Source Selection identifies and digests the exact source value relied upon independently from the diagnostic digest of its containing file.
formal_voice.expression: Selection = (selection_id, source_id, selector_kind, selector, id_field?, id_value?, selection_sha256)

symbols.meaning: SHA-256 of the selected exact Markdown bytes or canonical selected JSON value

boundary_conditions: A selector must resolve exactly once.
An unchanged selection does not make unrelated whole-file changes authoritative.

definitions.plain_language_voice: It fingerprints the exact section or record we are using, not merely the whole file around it.
definitions.domain_context_voice: A Product Thesis record can be selected as one canonical JSON value while a canonical Definition can be selected as one exact H2 section.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Resolve JSON pointers, stable ID-selected records, or exact Markdown headings deterministically and compare the selected digest.
definitions.forbidden_collapse: Not a second definition source, a promotion record, or proof that the containing file has no unrelated changes.
definitions.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus each selected source owner

formal_voice.normative_candidate: Registry Context Residue is a typed unresolved condition encountered during bounded resolution that remains visible with its subject, evidence, blocking effect, and owner route.
formal_voice.expression: Residue = (id, kind, subject, explanation, blocking, owner_route, source_selection_refs)

symbols.meaning: missing, stale, ambiguous, conflict, open-realization, or owner-unresolved

boundary_conditions: Blocking residue prevents a resolved status.
Residue cannot be cleared by inference or validator success alone.

definitions.plain_language_voice: It records what the context could not honestly settle and who should address it.
definitions.domain_context_voice: An unresolved DomainSpec realization or unresolved Registry Context runtime owner stays in the view instead of becoming a guessed binding.
definitions.operational_interpretation: Emit residue for every unresolved required or relevant condition; route it without silently resolving it.
definitions.forbidden_collapse: Not an error dump, automatic blocker for every use, or permission to ignore an unresolved owner decision.
definitions.owner_route: CyberAlchemy v2 product owner plus the owner of the unresolved subject
